fixes.explanation: Rest is lovely, and I've done a lot of it, mostly in a drawer. But here God says, "Work!" (Haggai 2:4) The people are building His house (Haggai 1:14). And He gives them a reason to keep going: "…I am with you…"

"The silver is Mine, and the gold is Mine, declares the LORD of Hosts." (Haggai 2:8) Plain and simple. The nations are bringing treasures, and God says the silver and gold belong to Him. So whatever they carry in was already His.
